sources.title: Introduction to transpilation
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Qiskit Randomized Benchmarking：衰減不是單閘保真度
related.titleEn: Qiskit randomized benchmarking: decay is not a single-gate fidelity
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：驗收須同時符合耦合圖、閘方向與末佈局；閘數較少不代表校準較差的邊也更可靠。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Require coupling, gate-direction and final-layout validity; fewer gates on poorly calibrated edges may not be better. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 把擬合α轉為平均每Clifford錯誤，清楚標示SPAM與模型假設。
related.differenceEn: Convert fittedα into average error perClifford while statingSPAM and model assumptions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。線形4點0–1–2–3，要在原邏輯q0與q3間作用CNOT；先把q0搬到位置2，允許末佈局改變。 CNOT數=2×3+1。 代入 2*3+1，得到 7 CNOTs。以3個CNOT分解一個SWAP，端點交互需兩個SWAP加1個目標CNOT；若強制復位再多兩個SWAP。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。

以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。擬合α=0.99，序列長度含1、10、20、50、100；A、B自由擬合。 EPC=(1−0.99)/2。 代入 (1-0.99)/2，得到 0.005 error/Clifford。單量子位元去極化模型下EPC=(1−α)/2，擬合P(m)=Aα^m+B；A與B吸收部分SPAM，不保證消除所有漂移。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. On line0–1–2–3, applyCNOT between originalq0/q3 by movingq0 to site2, initially allowing changed final layout. CNOT count=2×3+1. Substituting 2*3+1 gives 7 CNOTs. Using3CNOTs perSWAP, endpoint interaction requires twoSWAPs plus one targetCNOT; restoring layout adds two moreSWAPs. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Fitα=0.99 using lengths1,10,20,50,100 with freeA/B. EPC=(1−0.99)/2. Substituting (1-0.99)/2 gives 0.005 error/Clifford. For a one-qubit depolarizing modelEPC=(1−α)/2 withP(m)=Aα^m+B;A/B absorb someSPAM but not all drift. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Google QPU：Hahn echo 與低頻雜訊辨識
related.titleEn: Google QPU: Hahn echo and low-frequency noise discrimination
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：驗收須同時符合耦合圖、閘方向與末佈局；閘數較少不代表校準較差的邊也更可靠。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Require coupling, gate-direction and final-layout validity; fewer gates on poorly calibrated edges may not be better. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 建立『Google QPU：Hahn echo 與低頻雜訊辨識』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付等時窗對照、脈衝基線及噪聲頻段假說。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'Google QPU: Hahn echo and low-frequency noise discrimination', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver equal-window comparisons, pulse baseline and a noise-band hypothesis.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。線形4點0–1–2–3，要在原邏輯q0與q3間作用CNOT；先把q0搬到位置2，允許末佈局改變。 CNOT數=2×3+1。 代入 2*3+1，得到 7 CNOTs。以3個CNOT分解一個SWAP，端點交互需兩個SWAP加1個目標CNOT；若強制復位再多兩個SWAP。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：以 C(t)=exp(−t/T2)比較有效Ramsey與echo包絡；echo不消除能量鬆弛，亦非所有雜訊都可重聚焦。 使用教學t=40 μs、Ramsey有效T2=60 μs、echo有效T2=120 μs。 以手算或試算表計算名義式exp(-40/60)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：核對兩序列總延遲相同；用t=0正規化並把額外π脈衝誤差另外列出。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. On line0–1–2–3, applyCNOT between originalq0/q3 by movingq0 to site2, initially allowing changed final layout. CNOT count=2×3+1. Substituting 2*3+1 gives 7 CNOTs. Using3CNOTs perSWAP, endpoint interaction requires twoSWAPs plus one targetCNOT; restoring layout adds two moreSWAPs. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Compare effective Ramsey and echo envelopes C(t)=exp(−t/T2); echo removes neither relaxation nor every noise process. Use Teaching t=40 μs, effective Ramsey T2=60 μs and echo T2=120 μs. Evaluate nominal expression exp(-40/60) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Match total delays, normalize at t=0 and separately account for the extra π-pulse error.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
